## Backed-up task summary

The archive spans **823 tasks** created from **March 17 through August 11, 2026**. The strongest concentration occurred in **April 2026**, which accounts for just over half of all archived tasks.

| Creation month | Tasks | Share |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| April 2026 | 414 | 50.3% |
| June 2026 | 156 | 19.0% |
| May 2026 | 79 | 9.6% |
| July 2026 | 69 | 8.4% |
| August 2026 through Aug. 11 | 65 | 7.9% |
| March 2026 from Mar. 17 | 40 | 4.9% |
| **Total** | **823** | **100.0%** |

> **Peak period:** April plus June accounts for **570 tasks (69.3%)** of the complete backup.

### Title-based category breakdown

Because the archive does not carry a native category field, I classified each task from its title using a consistent first-match keyword taxonomy. The large **Research & general inquiries** group includes tasks whose titles did not contain the specific business, technology, media, AI, or lifestyle signals used by the other categories.

| Category | Tasks | Share |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Research & general inquiries | 663 | 80.6% |
| Software, automation & integrations | 57 | 6.9% |
| Property & real estate | 44 | 5.3% |
| Business operations & communications | 21 | 2.6% |
| AI, Manus & agent workflows | 15 | 1.8% |
| Media, design & music | 13 | 1.6% |
| Personal, travel & lifestyle | 10 | 1.2% |
| **Total** | **823** | **100.0%** |

### Archive status and type

| Measure | Count | Share |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Completed/stopped tasks | 788 | 95.7% |
| Waiting tasks | 34 | 4.1% |
| Running task at backup time | 1 | 0.1% |
| Standard tasks | 784 | 95.3% |
| Project tasks | 24 | 2.9% |
| Agent subtasks | 15 | 1.8% |

The most recent archived task was **“Backup and Push Tasks to GitHub”** on August 11, followed by a third-amendment research task and a Connecteam Breadcrumbs API task on August 10. The monthly figures are derived from the archive timestamps; categories are a useful organizational approximation rather than original Manus labels.
